result.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
result.summary: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出用 bilevel Stackelberg 形式让常规后验校准器与主干网络端到端联合训练，不再需要独立校准集与专门校准损失，只用交叉熵同时优化准确率与校准；实验显示直接把最后分类层当校准器即可达到准确且良好校准的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 校准与置信度可靠性与 LVR 中的「停止/选择性输出」决策可能相关，可供核查其双层联合训练思路是否能用于 latent 推理的停止判据或答案置信度校准；论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态。
